	id = DA_GB_corps.1	# Fireglass Forge: the Machine Hall (mirrors DA_ADK_explore.201)
	title = DA_GB_corps.mh.t
	desc = DA_GB_corps.1.d
	picture = GREAT_BUILDING_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = { DA_pre_setting_Dig_level_as_explored = yes }
	option = {
		name = DA_GB_corps.mh.a
		custom_tooltip = DA_Dwarovar_Wonder_found_tt
		custom_tooltip = DA_GB_machine_hall_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_province_flag = DA_Magma_forge_found
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge } } } add_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge instant = yes } }
		}
		DA_Set_level_as_explored = yes
	}
	after = {
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
			owner = { add_country_modifier = { name = DA_ADK_menu_cooldown duration = 10 hidden = yes } }
		}
	}
}
